notes.title: Mayday debuts at Gamescom 2025!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40858966/2d9d039eae76a8718a14a04dc1467876616aa13b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]From August 20 to 24, 2025 — come check out [i]Mayday[/i] live at Gamescom in Cologne![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [b]Mayday will be featured at Gamescom 2025[/b] at the [b]Indie.io[/b] booth! 🎉[/p][p]This is your chance to experience an [b]exclusive demo at the event[/b] and dive deeper into the game at the world’s biggest gaming show.[/p][p][b]Date:[/b] August 20–24, 2025[/p][p][b]Location:[/b] Gamescom, Cologne – [b]Hall 10.2, Booth F-011 (Indie.io)[/b][/p][p]The [b]Indie.io team[/b] will be happy to chat with you and hear your thoughts about the game. 💚[/p][p]And the best part: you don’t have to wait![/p][p]The [b]demo is already available here on Steam[/b] — you can play it right now and get a taste of what’s coming.[/p][p]Don’t forget to [b]add [i]Mayday[/i] to your Wishlist[/b] — your support means the world to us and helps the project grow.[/p][p]See you at Gamescom![/p][p][/p][h2]Stay tuned with Mayday![/h2][p align="start"]Join the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FszywZtzrsQ"]Discord[/url] to stay up to date with all the latest news![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40858966/02ebe0b8e243a7809c4fb1394d6242cf53b03f64.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2]Wishlist & Subscribe[/h2][p align="start"]Don’t forget to add [b][i]Mayday: The Survival Island[/i][/b] to your Wishlists![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1686230/Mayday_The_Survival_Island/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 📢 Update Released! Two New Inventory Slots + More Improvements
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’ve just pushed a new update based on community feedback. Here’s what’s included:[/p][p]🧳 [b]+2 Inventory Slots[/b] — One of the most requested features!
🐛 [b]Bug Fixes[/b] — Squashed several minor issues.
⚙️ [b]Performance Improvements[/b] — Smoother gameplay experience.
⚖️ [b]Balance Adjustments[/b] — Tweaks to improve overall game flow.[/p][p]We’re constantly working to make the game better, and your support means everything. Let us know what you think, and stay tuned for more updates![/p]

notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40858966/e5b05f0674689686aeeef129ac06206f37aa5288.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Mayday just took a huge step![/h2][p]We’ve got some exciting news to share: we’ve officially partnered with [b]indie.io[/b]! We’re thrilled to have the support of this amazing publisher, who will help us take [i]Mayday[/i] even further, and deliver an even better experience for all of you![/p][p][/p][h2]About game publishers[/h2][p]For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.[/p][p][/p][h2]Why we chose indie.io[/h2][p]At [b]Pequi Studios[/b], we believe that every great project needs a strong strategic partner. The team at indie.io shares our values and provides full support, allowing us to focus 100% of our energy on creating an incredible experience for the players of [i]Mayday: The Survival Island[/i].[/p][p][/p][h2]Check out other indie.io titles[/h2][p]They’ve supported some amazing games — be sure to visit the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio"]indie.io Steam Publisher Page[/url] and take a look![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40858966/02ebe0b8e243a7809c4fb1394d6242cf53b03f64.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Stay tuned with Mayday![/h2][p]Join the [url="https://discord.gg/szywZtzrsQ"]Discord[/url] to stay up to date with all the latest news![/p][p][/p][h2]Wishlist & Subscribe[/h2][p]Don’t forget to add [b][i]Mayday: The Survival Island[/i][/b] to your Wishlists![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1686230/Mayday_The_Survival_Island/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
